meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page, terminal, and paginated-document surfaces. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift, PDF page check, deck review, blank or near-empty page, wrong page break.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页、终端和文档的视觉效果,标出异常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完页面都担心显示效果
copy.tagline_en: Verify UI visuals on web, terminal, and documents via screenshot diffs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you change UI often and worry about visual regressions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在你构建或修改任何界面后做视觉质检：先截图或抓取终端画面，再用两个独立审查员分别检查设计系统/功能与视觉保真/CJK排版，最终给出“好/坏”的明确判定。
howto.when: 当你刚构建或修改完界面，或询问页面、组件、终端界面看起来是否正确时触发；提到“视觉QA”“截图对比”等关键词也会进入。

say.text: 我刚改了登录页，帮我做一次视觉QA。
say.note: 会对页面截图并跑双审查后给出通过/修改判定。

say.text: 对比这张设计稿和我的页面截图，看像素差异。
say.note: 会生成diff比例和热点区域。

say.text: 检查这个终端界面的对齐和边框有没有错位。
say.note: 会跑TUI宽度检查并看宽字符列。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude performs visual QA after you build or change any UI: it captures screenshots or terminal output, runs two independent reviewers for design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK checks, then gives a clear good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any UI, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right; keywords like "visual QA" or "screenshot diff" also enter this mode.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page; run visual QA on it.
say_en.note: Captures screenshots and runs dual review, then gives a pass/revise verdict.

say_en.text: Compare this design mock with my page screenshot for pixel differences.
say_en.note: Produces diff ratio and hotspot regions.

say_en.text: Check the terminal UI for alignment and broken borders.
say_en.note: Runs TUI width check and inspects wide-char columns.
